\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{listings,xcolor}
\newsavebox\lstbox
% Displayed listings in boxes in a paragraph (text.boxed_listings): a
% line wider than a phone's column, also in nested frames, captions at
% the bottom, and two listings in one box.
\begin{document}
\section{Boxed listings}
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
wide(); /* a line wider than the column of a phone screen */
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Wide \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $a$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Below env},captionpos=b]
bottomenv();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Bottom \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $b$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
twoA();
\end{lstlisting}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Above second}]
twoB();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Two \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $c$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Below first},captionpos=b]
pairA();
\end{lstlisting}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Above next}]
pairB();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Pair \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $d$.

% (a title, with no number and no anchor before it)
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
titleA();
\end{lstlisting}\begin{lstlisting}[title={Titled next}]
titleB();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Titled \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $e$.

% (the line wider than the column in a frame inside a frame, and in a
% raised box inside a frame)
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
wideA(); /* a line wider than the column of a phone screen */
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Nested \fbox{\fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}}} then $f$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
wideB(); /* a line wider than the column of a phone screen */
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Color \fbox{\colorbox{yellow}{\usebox{\lstbox}}} then $g$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
wideC(); /* a line wider than the column of a phone screen */
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Framed \colorbox{yellow}{\fcolorbox{red}{white}{\usebox{\lstbox}}} then $h$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
wideD(); /* a line wider than the column of a phone screen */
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Raised \fbox{\raisebox{1pt}{\usebox{\lstbox}}} then $i$.

% (spaces as wide as the letters, so that the columns line up)
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
a b c x;
abcde y;
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Aligned \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $j$.

% (centered on the line by default, at its top with boxpos=t, and with
% its last line on the baseline with boxpos=b)
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}
centerA();
centerB();
centerC();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Center \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $k$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[boxpos=t]
topA();
topB();
topC();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Top \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $l$.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[boxpos=b]
bottomA();
bottomB();
bottomC();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Bottom \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} then $m$.

% (boxpos=t with a caption and a label, whose anchors come between the
% box and the listing, and with a label alone; any other value centers
% the listing, as boxpos=m and boxpos=center)
\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Captioned top},label=lst:captop,boxpos=t]
capA();
capB();
capC();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Captop \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} done.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[label=lst:labtop,boxpos=t]
labA();
labB();
labC();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Labtop \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} done.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[boxpos=m]
midA();
midB();
midC();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Mid \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} done.

\begin{lrbox}{\lstbox}\begin{lstlisting}[boxpos=center]
namedA();
namedB();
namedC();
\end{lstlisting}\end{lrbox}
Named \fbox{\usebox{\lstbox}} done, after \ref{lst:captop}.

% (a bottom caption in a table cell, with no mark left in the page)
\begin{tabular}{l}\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Cell below},captionpos=b]
cell();
\end{lstlisting}\end{tabular}

% (frame=shadowbox with a black rulesepcolor: a shadow in the text's
% color, also in dark mode)
\begin{lstlisting}[frame=shadowbox,rulesepcolor=\color{black}]
blackshadow();
\end{lstlisting}

\end{document}
